name: bugfix
description: Standard workflow for a defect: reproduce it, diagnose the root cause, write the failing test, fix it, and prove the fix holds.

stages.purpose: Reproduce the failure and diagnose the root cause instead of guessing at a fix.
Record the reproduction, the diagnosis, and what was ruled out so the fix is defensible.
Write the failing test that encodes the bug before writing the fix.
Land the smallest change that fixes the root cause and nothing else.
Review the fix for side effects and for whether the guard against recurrence is real.

rules: Complete each stage before treating it as complete.
Do not change code before the failure reproduces; an unreproduced bug cannot be verified as fixed.
After the fix lands, re-run the reproduction from the first stage and the existing suite; the bugfix baseline runs the test step twice on purpose.
Do not claim verification that did not happen.
completion: The bug is fixed when the reproduction from the first stage passes, the written test passes, and the surrounding suite still passes.
